upgrade.sentenceEn: Residents of an American city tend to share the opinion that time saved on the road justifies the cost of upgrading its traffic light system.
upgrade.translationZh: 一座美国城市的居民普遍认为，升级交通信号灯系统所节省的通勤时间，足以证明其成本的合理性。

upgrade.sentenceEn: Take due caution in upgrading their products.
upgrade.translationZh: 在升级产品时要谨慎行事。

upward.sentenceEn: Kim concludes that "rags-to-riches entertainment media are an important cultural force that promotes and perpetuates beliefs in upward mobility".
upward.translationZh: 金得出结论：“白手起家类娱乐媒体是一种重要的文化力量，它宣扬并 perpetuates 人们对向上流动的信念。”
upward.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

upward.sentenceEn: And yet, young Americans today are struggling to earn more than their parents did at the same age, and upward mobility in the US actually compares unfavourably to that of other industrialised nations.
upward.translationZh: 然而，如今的美国年轻人正艰难地想要比父母在同年龄段时挣得更多，而美国的向上流动性实际上比其他工业化国家要差。
upward.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

upward.sentenceEn: The value of a college degree is diminishing, and our upward mobility is declining.

upward.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

upward.sentenceEn: As the ocean warms, a body of water called the Antarctic Polar Front—an upward movement of nutrient-rich sea that supports a huge abundance of marine life—is being pushed further south.
upward.translationZh: 随着海洋变暖，一片被称为南极极锋的水域——这片富含营养的海水向上运动，支撑着大量海洋生物的生存——正被推向更南端。

upward.sentenceEn: What is stated about people who believe in upward mobility?

upward.translationZh: 他们发现很难实现向上流动。

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: As uncomfortable as it may be to continuously receive, if you can respond with compassion, the situation will likely defuse much faster.

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: Honesty was deemed to be more of a sin than a virtue, since it made people feel uncomfortable , or at least it made the most powerful folks feel uncomfortable .

uncomfortable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: "The key to a race like this is getting comfortable being uncomfortable ," said Becca Pizzi, last year's women's champion.
uncomfortable.translationZh: 去年的女子冠军贝卡·皮齐说：“参加这类比赛的关键在于适应不舒适的状态。”

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: When confronted with an uncomfortable set of facts, the tendency is often to double down on their current position rather than publicly admit to being wrong.
uncomfortable.translationZh: 当面对一系列令人不安的事实时，人们往往会更加坚定自己当前的立场，而不是公开承认错误。

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: Good deeds can sometimes make people feel uncomfortable .

uncomfortable.sentenceEn: They are uncomfortable with parliament's anti-obesity debate.
uncomfortable.translationZh: 他们对议会关于反肥胖的辩论感到不安。

underlie.sentenceEn: A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector.
underlie.translationZh: 这些论点的一个核心主张认为，在全球范围内，肉类生产产生的温室气体比整个交通运输部门还要多。

underlie.sentenceEn: When someone is giving advice in order to make themselves feel more powerful, there is underlying anxiety to their behavior that recipients of the advice tend to notice.

underlie.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

underlie.sentenceEn: It is best to set boundaries in a way that takes into account the individual's underlying reasons for doing what they are doing to avoid unnecessary conflict and more stress.

unity.sentenceEn: Students meet at the university campus ( unity of place) for classes ( unity of action) during their 20s ( unity of time).
unity.translationZh: 学生们在20多岁时（时间统一）于大学校园（地点统一）参加课程学习（行动统一）。

unity.sentenceEn: If universities decide to engage in this learning model, they will have to cope with many organisational challenges that might shake their unity of place and action.
unity.translationZh: 如果大学决定采用这种学习模式，它们将不得不应对许多组织层面的挑战，这些挑战可能会动摇其在地点和活动上的统一性。

unity.sentenceEn: Kwanzaa is based on seven principles which are unity , self-determination, collective work and responsibility, cooperative economics, purpose, creativity and faith.
unity.translationZh: 宽扎节基于七大原则，分别是团结、自主、集体工作与责任、合作经济、目标、创造力和信仰。
unity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

unity.sentenceEn: A selected person pours water or juice from the unity cup into a bowl.
unity.translationZh: 一位选定的人将团结杯中的水或果汁倒入碗中。
unity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

unity.sentenceEn: they drink wine from the unity cup.

unknown.sentenceEn: Left alone on an unknown island with no apparent prospect of rescue or escape, Crusoe has much to lament(悲叹).
unknown.translationZh: 独自一人被困在一座陌生的岛屿上，没有明显的获救或逃生希望，鲁滨逊有太多事情可以悲叹。

unknown.sentenceEn: We need to carefully examine our lives and our fears, and to ask ourselves whether our attitudes come from our personal knowledge and experience or from rumors and fear of the unknown .
unknown.translationZh: 我们需要仔细审视自己的生活和恐惧，并问问自己：我们的态度是源于亲身的了解和经历，还是源于谣言和对未知的恐惧。
unknown.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

unknown.sentenceEn: Nowadays, there are unknown , unorthodox opera singers wowing(博得……的喝彩) viewers on TV programs like "America's Got Talent" and "The Voice".
unknown.translationZh: 如今，一些名不见经传、风格另类的歌剧演唱家正在《美国达人秀》和《美国好声音》等电视节目中惊艳观众。

unknown.sentenceEn: An unfamiliar digital human that has been created through CGI will also face the same challenge as an unknown actor: they don't have the appeal of an established name.
unknown.translationZh: 一个通过计算机生成图像技术创造的陌生数字人，也将面临与不知名演员相同的挑战：他们缺乏知名演员所具备的吸引力。

unknown.sentenceEn: Marcel Proust, another lover of the Louvre, wrote: "It is only through art that we can escape from ourselves and know how another person sees the universe, whose landscapes would otherwise have remained as unknown as any on the moon."
unknown.translationZh: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特，另一位卢浮宫的爱好者，曾写道：“唯有通过艺术，我们才能逃离自我，了解他人如何看待这个宇宙。若非如此，他人眼中的世界景观将如月球上的任何景象一样不为人知。”
unknown.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

unknown.sentenceEn: It was relatively unknown to the outside.

unpredictable.sentenceEn: Life could be unpredictable out west—gold failed to appear, drought ruined farmers and settlers clashed with Native Americans.
unpredictable.translationZh: 西部的生活难以预料——黄金难觅踪影，干旱使农民颗粒无收，定居者还与美洲原住民发生冲突。
unpredictable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

unpredictable.sentenceEn: It's likely the " unpredictable , uncontrollable and ongoing nature of day-to-day email in terms of volume, importance and urgency" contributes to their levels of anxiety and to diminished leadership skills.
unpredictable.translationZh: 很可能是日常电子邮件在数量、重要性和紧急程度方面所具有的那种“不可预测、难以控制且持续不断的特性”，加剧了他们的焦虑情绪，并削弱了他们的领导能力。
unpredictable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

unpredictable.sentenceEn: There's unpredictable weather, changes in soil quality, and the ever-present possibility that pests and diseases may pay a visit.
unpredictable.translationZh: 天气变幻莫测，土壤质量也会变化，而且病虫害随时可能来袭。

unpredictable.sentenceEn: First, the number of students would be unpredictable .
unpredictable.translationZh: 首先，学生人数将难以预测。

unpredictable.sentenceEn: A youngest brother of brothers, often unpredictable and romantic, will match best with an oldest sister of brothers.
unpredictable.translationZh: 家中男孩里年纪最小的弟弟，往往难以捉摸又富有浪漫气质，最适合与家中男孩里年纪最大的姐姐结为伴侣。
unpredictable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

unpredictable.sentenceEn: They will no longer possess the human characteristic of being unpredictable .
unpredictable.translationZh: 他们将不再拥有人类所特有的不可预测性。

unsold.sentenceEn: The practice of destroying unsold stock, and even rolls of unused fabric, is commonplace for luxury labels.
unsold.translationZh: 对于奢侈品牌而言，销毁未售出的库存，甚至整卷未使用的面料，是一种常见做法。

unsold.sentenceEn: In March, a report revealed that H&M was struggling with $4.3 billion worth of unsold stock.
unsold.translationZh: 今年3月，一份报告显示H&M积压了价值43亿美元的未售出库存。

unsold.sentenceEn: One investor commenting on the Burberry figures was reportedly outraged that the unsold goods were not even offered to investors before they were destroyed.
unsold.translationZh: 据报道，一位投资者在评论博柏利的数据时感到愤怒，认为这些未售出的商品在被销毁前甚至没有提供给投资者。

unsold.sentenceEn: At the moment, the partnership only addresses waste at the production stage and not unsold goods.
unsold.translationZh: 目前，该合作关系仅处理生产阶段产生的废料，而非未售出的商品。

unsold.sentenceEn: One luxury brand employee quit her job because she simply couldn't bear to see the destruction of unsold products.
unsold.translationZh: 一位奢侈品牌员工辞去了工作，因为她实在无法忍受目睹未售出产品被销毁。

unsold.sentenceEn: they facilitate the donation of unsold foods to the needy.
unsold.translationZh: 它们便于农场和超市将未售出的食品捐赠给有需要的人。

upper.sentenceEn: Ralph Whitehead, a professor of journalism at the University of Massachusetts at Amherst, thinks it's because Boston's upper class used manners to make class distinctions.
upper.translationZh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校新闻学教授拉尔夫·怀特黑德认为，这是因为波士顿的上层阶级用礼仪来区分社会阶层。
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

upper.sentenceEn: Otherwise, the inborn biological upper hand that protectionists have in the form of nationalist solidarity is bound to win the day at the ballot box.
upper.translationZh: 否则，保护主义者凭借民族主义团结所获得的先天生物学优势，必将在投票箱中获胜。

upper.sentenceEn: Architects have identified three main holes in the structure, in the locations of the spire, the main hall and the upper rooms to the north of the central aisle.
upper.translationZh: 建筑师们已确认建筑结构上存在三个主要破损处，分别位于尖塔、主殿以及中央走道北侧的上层房间位置。

upper.sentenceEn: The findings challenged the idea that homework was "inherently good." The researchers concluded that there was an upper limit to the correlation between homework and achievement, suggesting that high school students shouldn't be doing more than two hours of homework a night.
upper.translationZh: 这些研究结果对家庭作业"天生有益"的观点提出了挑战。研究人员得出结论，家庭作业与学业成绩之间的相关性存在上限，建议高中生每晚的家庭作业不应超过两小时。
upper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

upper.sentenceEn: Consulting a random doctor patients will never meet, they say, further fragments the health-care system, and even minor issues such as upper respiratory(上呼吸道的) infections can't be thoroughly evaluated by a doctor who can't listen to your heart or feel your swollen glands.
upper.translationZh: 他们表示，咨询一位患者素未谋面的随机医生会进一步分割医疗系统，而且像上呼吸道感染这样的小病，医生如果无法听诊心脏或触摸肿大的腺体，也无法进行彻底评估。

upper.sentenceEn: It was adopted by Boston's upper class.
upper.translationZh: 它被波士顿的上层阶级所采纳。

uncertainty.sentenceEn: Whilst we like to eliminate uncertainty in our lives at some level we have to manage uncertainty , especially in today's volatile and ever-shifting job market.
uncertainty.translationZh: 虽然我们在某种程度上都希望消除生活中的不确定性，但我们必须学会管理不确定性，尤其是在当今这个动荡且不断变化的就业市场中。
uncertainty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

uncertainty.sentenceEn: Although there are huge uncertainties as to the precise impacts of climate change, enough is known to say that global warming represents one of the main threats to Africa's prosperity.
uncertainty.translationZh: 尽管气候变化的确切影响存在巨大的不确定性，但我们已经掌握足够信息，可以断言全球变暖是非洲繁荣面临的主要威胁之一。

uncertainty.sentenceEn: This is especially true as the study makes clear that information presented as fact evokes special responses in our brains, which are distinct from when we process the same content with clear indicators of uncertainty .
uncertainty.translationZh: 这一点尤为正确，因为该研究明确表明，以事实形式呈现的信息会在我们的大脑中引发特殊反应，这与我们处理带有明确不确定性指示词的相同内容时的反应截然不同。
uncertainty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

uncertainty.sentenceEn: There is uncertainty about how a recruiter will perceive their disability.
uncertainty.translationZh: 求职者不确定招聘人员会如何看待他们的残疾问题。
uncertainty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

uncertainty.sentenceEn: Hope, for Bloch, has its starting point in fear, in uncertainty , and in crisis: it is a creative force that goes hand in hand with utopian(乌托邦的) 'wishful images'.
uncertainty.translationZh: 在布洛赫看来，希望始于恐惧、不确定性和危机：它是一种创造性力量，与乌托邦式的"愿景意象"密不可分。

uncertainty.sentenceEn: It has been driven by fear, and it is creating even more fear as money problems and uncertainty grow.
uncertainty.translationZh: 社交距离措施源于恐惧，而随着经济困境加剧和不确定性增加，它又在制造更多恐惧。
uncertainty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

unintended.sentenceEn: The first is that the promises of technology will never be realised as fully as we hope; they will be limited by their unforeseen and unintended consequences.
unintended.translationZh: 首先，技术所承诺的愿景永远不会像我们希望的那样完全实现；它们会受到各种未预见和非预期后果的限制。
unintended.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

unintended.sentenceEn: This unintended impact has to do with the portrayal of conflict in media and how preschool-age children comprehend that conflict.
unintended.translationZh: 这种意外影响与媒体中冲突的呈现方式以及学龄前儿童如何理解这些冲突有关。
unintended.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

unintended.sentenceEn: Moreover, if history is a guide, then we can assume that any major transformations will once again be followed by a huge set of unintended consequences.
unintended.translationZh: 此外，如果以史为鉴，我们可以推测任何重大变革都将再次引发一系列意想不到的后果。

unintended.sentenceEn: CubeSat researchers suggest that now's the time to ponder unexpected and unintended possible consequences of more people than ever having access to their own small slice of space.
unintended.translationZh: 立方体卫星研究人员指出，现在是时候思考一个问题：当前所未有的人都能拥有自己的一小片太空，这可能会带来哪些意外和非预期的后果。

unintended.sentenceEn: But there's a danger they're ill-equipped to think through potential unintended consequences.
unintended.translationZh: 但存在一种危险，即他们不具备充分思考潜在意外后果的能力。

unintended.sentenceEn: About half of them are unintended .
unintended.translationZh: 全球约有一半的怀孕是意外怀孕。

unpaid.sentenceEn: They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent.
unpaid.translationZh: 他们的处境也更有利，可以从事无薪实习来迈出职场第一步，同时由父母支付房租。
unpaid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

unpaid.sentenceEn: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.
unpaid.translationZh: 部分原因是女性承担了更多的无偿家务劳动，这会占用她们本可用于工作的时间，消耗她们职业发展所需的精力。
unpaid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

unpaid.sentenceEn: So, to gain access to an automated service that will benefit financially from my input, I first have to do some unpaid labor to help improve the performance of autonomous vehicles.
unpaid.translationZh: 所以，为了获得一项能从我的输入中获利的自动化服务，我首先得干些义务劳动，去帮他们改进自动驾驶汽车的性能。
unpaid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

unpaid.sentenceEn: After three years of working in a petrol station and doing unpaid work, I still hadn't managed to get an entry-level job.
unpaid.translationZh: 在加油站工作了三年，期间还做了不少无薪工作，但我仍然没能找到一份入门级的工作。
unpaid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

unpaid.sentenceEn: Office workers do around two billion hours of unpaid overtime each year.
unpaid.translationZh: 办公室职员每年约有20亿小时属于无偿加班。
unpaid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

unpaid.sentenceEn: Approximately 60% of student debt remains unpaid .
unpaid.translationZh: 大约60%的学生贷款尚未偿还。

unrealistic.sentenceEn: In the physical world, the struggle goes against the underlying pressure exerted on women to conform to an unrealistic beauty ideal.
unrealistic.translationZh: 在现实世界中，这场抗争是为了对抗迫使女性符合不切实际的 beauty 标准的潜在压力。
unrealistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

unrealistic.sentenceEn: They measured three types of perfectionism: self-oriented, or a desire to be perfect; socially prescribed, or a desire to live up to others' expectations; and other-oriented, or holding others to unrealistic standards.
unrealistic.translationZh: 他们测量了三种类型的完美主义：自我导向型，即渴望做到完美；社会规定型，即渴望达到他人的期望；以及他人导向型，即对他人抱有不切实际的标准。

unrealistic.sentenceEn: This shift away from unrealistic expectations is successful because entitled employees feel more confident that ethical leaders will deliver on their promises.
unrealistic.translationZh: 这种摆脱不切实际期望的转变之所以成功，是因为有权利感的员工更加相信道德型领导者会兑现承诺。
unrealistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

unrealistic.sentenceEn: The notion that they're utterly powerless suddenly seems unrealistic —not to mention rather annoying—so they're prompted instead to generate ideas about how they might change things.
unrealistic.translationZh: 他们完全无能为力的想法突然显得不切实际——更不用说是相当令人恼火的——因此反而会促使他们思考如何改变现状。
unrealistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

unrealistic.sentenceEn: The conditions creating the stress are long hours, unrealistic demands and deadlines, and work-life conflict.
unrealistic.translationZh: 造成压力的工作环境因素包括工作时间过长、不切实际的要求和截止期限，以及工作与生活的冲突。
他们抱有不切实际的期望。
